title: Mexicans view President Claudia Sheinbaum favorably, but less so than in 2025
summary_en: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum remains popular, but her favorability has dropped to 64%. Views of the economy and democracy are also declining.
title_cn: Mexicans view President Claudia Sheinbaum favorably, but less so than in 2025

title: How we measured Americans’ engagement in public life
summary_en: This piece explains how researchers measured Americans’ engagement in public life using multimode surveys, address-based sampling and cluster analysis.
title_cn: How we measured Americans’ engagement in public life

title: How Americans Are Engaged With News, Politics, Religion and Civic Life
summary_en: Americans’ engagement with others is not one-dimensional. Instead, they sort into four distinct groups that reflect different patterns of participation in society.
title_cn: How Americans Are Engaged With News, Politics, Religion and Civic Life

title: People in Many Countries Now View China More Positively Than the U.S.
summary_en: Views of China have improved recently while views of the U.S. have worsened, to the point where China is now seen more positively than the U.S. in most countries surveyed.
title_cn: People in Many Countries Now View China More Positively Than the U.S.

title: Views of China and Xi Are Improving Globally
summary_en: Growing shares of people see China favorably and have confidence in Xi Jinping, though opinions are much less positive in wealthier nations.
title_cn: Views of China and Xi Are Improving Globally

title: Party Affiliation Fact Sheet (NPORS)
summary_en: Explore trends in partisan identification among U.S. adults using data from Pew Research Center’s National Public Opinion Reference Survey (NPORS).

title: National Public Opinion Reference Survey (NPORS)
summary_en: NPORS is an annual survey of U.S. adults conducted by the Pew Research Center used to to produce benchmark estimates for several topics.
